**Best move:** Qxd3+

**Main line:** Qxd3+ Ke1 Rxc1#

**Motif:** Deflection / Attraction (the check forces the king to e1, enabling back rank mate)

**Coaching Note:**

When your opponent's king has limited escape squares, look for forcing moves that drive it into the corner. Here, Qxd3+ forces Ke1, which walks into Rxc1# on the back rank. The winning pattern: **identify when the enemy king lacks escape squares, then find a forcing move (check or threat) that drives it to the lethal square.** Your rook controlled the c-file the whole time—you just needed to clear it with the right tempo.
